title: malleola rosea
intro: Malleola rosea, commonly known as the "Golden Ghost" or "Malleola," is a rare and endangered orchid species native to the tropical forests of Southeast Asia. This plant has been found to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Malleola rosea include antimicrobial and antifungal activities, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of certain infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
